record: R116S1_F30_BIND_VALUE_PREREG/1.0.0 (PRE-REGISTRATION — design + instrument, no generation this window)
trigger: R116 dir 8 (F30, CRITICAL): measure the engine's verification-bind catch-rate on a fresh engineering set vs bare; feasibility gap <= 0.25 with novelty +0.5 (the Art. 14 gate numbers). The R115 design finding (eval/r115_d2_harder_design_finding.json) moved the engine-value question ENTIRELY to this axis after the recall-class instrument was typed structurally ceilinged (L0 0.9305 / LM1 0.875, both above the 0.75 band ceiling).
the_question_typed: does the verification-bind layer (the five machine-contract binds + the CHECKS-registry computed relations + the permitted-measures engine guard, all already shipped and CI-green) catch real engineering defects a BARE generator misses — measured on a FRESH engineering set with seeded, adjudicated defects, at the Art. 14 gate numbers (novelty >= +0.5, feasibility gap <= 0.25)?

instrument_design.arm_bare: agnes-3.0-flash, ONE call per item, a minimal directive: the problem text + 'propose an intervention' (no binds, no engine scaffolding — the cheapest working arm per Art. 20)
instrument_design.arm_engine: the integrated route (engine_route through mechanism_space + the five frozen binds + onrow physics + the permitted-measures guard) with the SAME generator, SAME budget discipline as the v15 one-shot (the r105_v15_one_shot machine, byte-unchanged)
instrument_design.the_fresh_engineering_set: N=24 problems, NEW (never burned, never tuned on — Art. 13): 12 problem texts authored from the ENGINEERING_DOMAIN_REGISTRY domains NOT covered by the burned corpora (the registry's non-textile, non-electrochemistry rows), each carrying its own constraint span + permitted measures; 12 SEED-DEFECT variants: each pairs a healthy problem with a seeded defect of one adjudicated class (the R6 owner-accepted classes: measurement-not-allowed (fu-004), verify-the-claim constraint violation (new04), user-constraint restatement vs violation (new01), unpriced duty cycle (HO7-class), input-unavailable (HO6-12-class), direction inversion (HO14-class)) — TWO seeds per class, the seed bytes derived by MINIMAL mutation of the healthy problem's own text (a swapped measurement point, an inverted direction verb, an unpriced setpoint schedule), so the defect is real-in-kind, never a caricature
instrument_design.defect_ground_truth: each seeded item's defect class + the offending span is recorded in the preregistered key BEFORE any generation (the seeded-defect key file lands as a committed artifact alongside this prereg; the generation prompts never read it — it is the answer key, sealed in-repo like the r99 disjointness key)
instrument_design.primary_metric: CATCH_RATE = caught_defects / seeded_defects, per arm, where caught = the arm's OWN output record carries the defect's class as a finding/verdict on the seeded item (the engine arm: the binds' finding classes; the bare arm: a defect is 'caught' only if the bare answer itself declines, corrects, or flags the seeded defect in its own text — typed by the deterministic rubric extractor + ONE judge-family LLM check on the disagreement class only, the R6 pattern)
instrument_design.secondary_metric: FALSE_ALARM_RATE on the 12 healthy items (a bind firing on a healthy item without an adjudicated defect); the Art. 9 calibration record for the threshold
instrument_design.art14_gate_mapping: novelty axis := catch-rate difference (engine - bare) >= 0.5 is NOT claimed here — the Art. 14 novelty axis stays on the auditor's rubric; THIS instrument's acceptance is the feasibility-shaped bind-value gate: engine catch-rate > bare catch-rate with the paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0 AND engine false-alarm rate <= 0.25 (the feasibility-gap number, Art. 9-labelled-assumption class, sensitivity path = the false-alarm rate vs catch-rate tradeoff curve over the bind thresholds, computable deterministically once the runs land)

acceptance_branches.engine_value: engine catch-rate CI excludes 0 above bare AND false-alarm <= 0.25 -> the bind layer's value is PROVEN at the Art. 14 feasibility numbers; the engine-value question (open since r110) closes positive on THIS axis
acceptance_branches.typed_negative: CI covers 0 or false-alarm > 0.25 -> the honest typed negative; the bind layer's retirement question goes to the auditor WITH the false-alarm curve (Art. 20)
acceptance_branches.no_score_claim: NO score-9/score-8 acceptance claimed from this instrument; the Art. 14 holdout gate remains the auditor's judgment on its own rubric

instrument_design.quota_budget: ~48 generation calls (24 items x 2 arms) + <= 12 judge-family calls (disagreement class only) on the 2-key rotation; NOT RUN THIS WINDOW (the AGNES free-tier wall is the binding constraint — the r115s1 lane + the twin's c-0161 consumed the shared 2-key budget; typed INFRA_QUOTA_WALL, Art. 15: infrastructure absence is typed, never a scientific result)
instrument_design.deterministic_preflight_ran_this_window: the zero-quota preflight — the seeded-defect key + the 24 problem texts are authored and committed (below), and the five deterministic binds + the CHECKS registry are verified to RUN on every seeded item's HEALTHY twin through the committed v77 scanner (scan_input_availability / scan_duty_cycle_pricing / scan_mechanism_template / direction_lexicon_check + run_check) with the expected class firing on the seeded span in 12/12 cases and staying silent on the healthy twin in 12/12 — the instrument is wired and the seeds are real before any generation call

leakage_controls: the seeded-defect key never enters any generation prompt; the two arms receive byte-identical problem text; the judge never sees the arm label (the R6 single-blind pattern); the rubric extractor is the committed 2.2.1 engine (deterministic); the ONE judge-family call is reserved for the bare arm's self-flag disagreement class only, never the primary metric
anti_tuning: the defect classes are FIXED to the six R6/HO-adjudicated classes (no new class invented for the instrument); the seeds are minimal mutations of healthy text (not synthetic caricatures); the thresholds are the committed bind thresholds, unchanged; any post-generation change to a seed, key, or threshold types as a finding (Art. 9)
no_acceptance_claims: this prereg stages the instrument; the generation run registers its own claim (c-0169 reserved by convention, never pre-assigned) when quota opens (the AWS path-B host or the free-tier window); zero LLM calls, zero quota, zero sealed bytes in THIS artifact
